indications: Meclizine hydrochloride tablets are indicated for the treatment of vertigo associated with diseases affecting the vestibular system in adults.
contraindications: Recommended dosage: 25 mg to 100 mg daily, in divided doses ( 2.1 ). Tablets: Swallow whole ( 2.2 ).
adverseReactions:
Meclizine hydrochloride tablets are contraindicated in patients with a hypersensitivity to meclizine or any of the inactive ingredients
 
  [see 
  
   Adverse Reactions (6)and
  
   Description (11)].
name: MECLIZINE HYDROCHLORIDE
